title: Cardano Mendix plug-in by the Landano team

ms.promise:
Objective: Kick off the project and finalize detailed requirements for the core features of the Mendix widgets and modules.
Activities: Initial team meetings, stakeholder consultations, and requirement documentation.
Tangible Outputs:
・Produce documented project plan and timeline, including clear documentation of the project scope and boundaries.
・Produce comprehensive list of requirements for Mendix widgets and modules, validated by stakeholder feedback and other contextual information for situating system decisions in stakeholder centered design.
ms.criteria:
・The project plan has been written, the scope has been determined and the project’s boundaries have been identified. In case of new insights that will require a change of milestones, a change request has been filed.
・The requirements have been identified together with the stake holders in the form of Epics and User Stories
ms.report:
・The project plan has been written, the scope has been determined and the project’s boundaries have been identified. 
・The requirements have been identified together with the stake holders in the form of Epics and User Stories

・The project plan can be found at https://www.landano.io/project-catalyst/fund-11/
・﻿﻿﻿An export report from Jira can be found at https://www.landano.io/project-catalyst/fund-11/

ms.promise:
Objective: Develop a streamlined prototype focusing on key functionalities.
Activities: Design and coding of the prototype, incorporating essential features.
Tangible Outputs:
・Completed prototype with core functionalities as outlined in the requirements.
・Internal review and validation of the prototype's technical performance.
・Initial user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) design, generated in accordance with the standards outlined in milestone 1.
ms.criteria:
・A Mendix project has been created and a prototype has been created that contains the core functionalities.
・Review and validation documents have been created by members of the Landano team
・The UI/UX design have been documented according to the standards outlined in milestone 1.
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
Thank you for your valuable feedback. In response, we’ve reorganized the Proof of Achievement to make it more accessible. Unfortunately, Figma requires a password for sharing, which is why we’ve provided one for your convenience. You can find the password in the feedback document. If you encounter any issues, you are welcome to create a Figma account, and we’ll gladly provide the necessary access.
All Proof of Achievement materials are available on our website: https://www.landano.io/project-catalyst/fund-11/
Under Milestone 2, you’ll find the following documents and links:
・Feedback Document (outlining the core functionality of this prototype)
・GitHub Repository for the Cardano Mendix Plugin
・Figma: UX/UI Document (password in the Feedback Document)
・UX/UI Feedback (raw data, also included in the Feedback Document)
・Prototype Feedback (raw data, also included in the Feedback Document)

We hope this reorganization meets your expectations and addresses your feedback effectively.
Kind regards,
The Landano Team

Tangible Outputs:
 A report:

ms.promise:
Objective: Launch a working release candidate of the plugin; close out project.
Activities: Final development iterations, complete documentation, and prepare for official release. 
Tangible Outputs: 
・Final release of the Cardano Mendix plugin produced, incorporating all planned features and improvements based on beta testing.
・Comprehensive supporting documentation generated, including user guides and developer resources, ready for distribution.
・Successful completion of all final tests, ensuring product stability and security.
・A closeout video, created following all requirements.
・A closeout report, created following all requirements.
ms.criteria:
・A release candidate version of the Cardano Mendix plugin has been developed, incorporating all planned features and improvements identified during the beta testing phase.
・Comprehensive documentation, including user guides, developer resources, and installation instructions, has been generated and is ready for distribution.
・All final tests have been successfully completed, ensuring the product's stability, security, and readiness for official release.
・The closeout video and report follow all Catalyst requirements.
ms.report:
There are five Evidences of completion listed under this final milestone for this project. They can all be found listed under the Final Milestone heading at our project page on our website: https://www.landano.io/project-catalyst/fund-11/
The prototype can be found at: https://cardanomendixplug-in-sandbox.mxapps.io/
Please note that as this prototype is running in a sandbox environment it may take some time to load completely.
